narrative: A loose leaf, not the tied bundle. The bundle sits apart, still knotted in red. Candlelight. No face. The page stops before any drinking. One word under the two lines, with a space after it. She has not drunk. The vial is named by the scene and not emptied on the page. The red-tied bundle at the far side of the board, unopened. This leaf is not added to it.
